X7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
These are K562 CRISPRi knockdowns, not A549 dexamethasone. A floor measured here
transfers to the A549 series as an order of magnitude, not as a number.
The X matrix is the NORMALIZED one -- already z-scored against non-targeting
controls within gem group -- so some cell-to-cell variance was removed before we
saw it. That biases within-perturbation variance DOWN and reliability UP.
A split-half shares library prep, day and gem group between halves, so X3 measures
reproducibility of sampling, not of the experiment.
